# FLX-3618: a consumer query or view does not parse

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

The text is read by sqlglot in the dialect the consumers block declares, and it did not tokenize or parse there, or it holds no statement at all. The message names the query or view and sqlglot's own reading of the first problem. Fix the text, or declare the dialect it is written in.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3618
```

Every code is listed in the [error index](./README.md).
